## FILE\_KEY variable

Symbol key for uploaded files in parsed multipart body. Use this key to access files from the parsed body object:

**Signature:**

```typescript
FILE_KEY: unique symbol
```

## Example

const files = parsedBody\[FILE\_KEY\];
